Their orders, kept under the chapel's altar, were to keep it asleep, and never let it be joined to the rest of itself.\For four hundred years they listened to it and never answered. Then Marshal Corvane asked it a question. Half the Order followed him; the cook walked into the lake; the last of them, Ysolde, kept the watch alone.\I don't know yet what 'the rest of itself' is.
